translations.text: Un golpe hacia abajo la hizo rebotar en la pizarra y pasar por encima de la bola que estorbaba.

translations.text: Ein Stoß nach unten ließ sie von der Platte abprallen und über die Kugel im Weg springen.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: Mientras la bola se deslizaba, el paño la arrastró en la dirección del deslizamiento de su efecto, no en la de su movimiento.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: Tant que la bille glissait, le tapis l'a tirée dans le sens du glissement de son effet, pas dans celui de son mouvement.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: Solange die Kugel rutschte, zog das Tuch sie in Richtung des Rutschens ihres Effets, nicht in ihre Laufrichtung.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: Enquanto a bola deslizava, o pano puxou-a no sentido do deslize do efeito, não no do movimento.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: 球が滑っている間、ラシャは進む向きではなく、回転による滑りの向きに球を引っぱった。

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: 공이 미끄러지는 동안, 천은 공을 움직이는 방향이 아니라 회전으로 미끄러지는 방향으로 끌었어.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: 球在滑动时，台布沿着它旋转造成的打滑方向拉它，而不是沿着它运动的方向。

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: Пока шар скользил, сукно тянуло его по направлению проскальзывания от вращения, а не по направлению движения.

translations.key: While the ball slid, the cloth pulled it along the slip of its spin, not along its motion.
translations.text: بينما كانت الكرة تنزلق، سحبها الجوخ في اتجاه انزلاق دورانها، لا في اتجاه حركتها.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: Ein Stoß, mehr als eine Kugel versenkt.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: Un colpo, più di una palla in buca.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: Uma tacada, mais de uma bola dentro.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: Uma tacada, mais de uma bola encaçapada.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: 一打で、2つ以上の球が落ちた。

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: 한 번 쳐서 공이 두 개 이상 들어갔어.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: 一杆，不止一颗球落袋。

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: Один удар, больше одного шара в лузе.

translations.key: One stroke, more than one ball down.
translations.text: ضربة واحدة، وأكثر من كرة في الجيب.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: El efecto de retroceso duró más que el golpe y tiró de la blanca hacia atrás.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: L'effet rétro a survécu au choc et a ramené la blanche en arrière.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: Der Rückwärtsdrall überdauerte den Treffer und zog die Weiße zurück.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: L'effetto indietro è durato più dell'impatto e ha riportato indietro la bianca.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: O efeito de recuo durou mais do que o impacto e puxou a branca para trás.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: O efeito de recuo durou mais que o impacto e puxou a branca para trás.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: 逆回転が衝突のあとも残り、手球を引き戻した。

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: 백스핀이 충돌 뒤에도 남아서 큐볼을 뒤로 끌어당겼어.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: 回旋比撞击持续得更久，把母球拉了回来。

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: Обратное вращение пережило удар и потянуло биток назад.

translations.key: Backspin outlasted the hit and pulled the cue ball back.
translations.text: صمد الدوران الخلفي بعد الاصطدام وسحب الكرة البيضاء إلى الوراء.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: El efecto se acabó justo en el contacto, así que toda la velocidad pasó a la otra bola.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: L'effet s'est épuisé pile au contact, donc toute la vitesse est passée à l'autre bille.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: Der Effet war genau beim Kontakt aufgebraucht, also ging das ganze Tempo weiter.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: L'effetto si è esaurito proprio al contatto, così tutta la velocità è passata all'altra palla.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: O efeito acabou mesmo no contacto, por isso toda a velocidade passou para a outra bola.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: O efeito acabou bem no contato, então toda a velocidade passou para a outra bola.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: 回転がちょうど接触の瞬間に尽きたので、速さはすべて相手の球へ渡った。

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: 회전이 딱 접촉 순간에 다 풀려서, 속도가 전부 다른 공으로 넘어갔어.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: 旋转恰好在接触时耗尽，所以全部速度都传了出去。

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: Вращение кончилось ровно в момент контакта, и вся скорость ушла дальше.

translations.key: The spin ran out exactly at contact, so all the speed went on.
translations.text: نفد الدوران تماماً عند التلامس، فانتقلت السرعة كلها إلى الأمام.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: La bola cruzó el agujero más rápido de lo que podía caer.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: La bille a traversé le trou plus vite qu'elle ne pouvait y tomber.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: Die Kugel lief schneller über das Loch, als sie hineinfallen konnte.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: La palla ha attraversato il buco più veloce di quanto potesse cadervi.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: A bola atravessou o buraco mais depressa do que conseguia cair.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: A bola atravessou o buraco mais rápido do que conseguia cair.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: 球は落ちきれないほどの速さで穴を通り過ぎた。

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: 공이 떨어질 수 있는 것보다 빠르게 구멍을 지나갔어.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: 球越过洞口的速度太快，来不及落下去。

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: Шар пересёк лузу быстрее, чем успел в неё упасть.

translations.key: The ball crossed the hole faster than it could fall in.
translations.text: عبرت الكرة الحفرة أسرع من أن تسقط فيها.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Un tope desvió la bola hacia el hoyo.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Un plot a dévié la bille dans le trou.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Ein Pfosten lenkte die Kugel ins Loch.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Un respingente ha deviato la palla nella buca.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Um pino de borracha desviou a bola para o buraco.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Um pino de borracha desviou a bola para o buraco.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: バンパーが球の向きを変え、カップへ入れた。

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: 범퍼가 공의 방향을 바꿔 컵에 넣었어.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: 挡柱把球拐进了球洞。

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: Столбик развернул шар в лунку.

translations.key: A bumper turned the ball into the cup.
translations.text: حوّل مصدٌّ مسار الكرة إلى الحفرة.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Solo cayó el bolo rojo.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Seule la quille rouge est tombée.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Nur der rote Kegel ist gefallen.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: È caduto solo il birillo rosso.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Só caiu o pino vermelho.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Só o pino vermelho caiu.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: 倒れたのは赤ピンだけ。

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: 빨간 핀만 쓰러졌어.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: 只有红柱倒下了。

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: Упала только красная кегля.

translations.key: Only the red pin fell.
translations.text: لم يسقط إلا الوتد الأحمر.

translations.text: 慢放这一杆，并把物理画在球台上

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Cada tiro de truco se puede ver así: la solución y luego la Lente.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Chaque coup spectaculaire peut se regarder comme ça : la solution, puis la Lentille.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Jeder Trickstoß lässt sich so ansehen: die Lösung, dann die Lens.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Ogni colpo spettacolare si può guardare così: la soluzione, poi la Lens.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Cada jogada de efeito pode ser vista assim: a solução e depois a Lente.

translations.text: Toda tacada de efeito pode ser vista assim: a solução e depois a Lente.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: どのトリックショットもこうして見られる。まず答え、それからレンズで。

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: 모든 트릭 샷을 이렇게 볼 수 있어. 먼저 정답, 그다음 렌즈로.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: 每个花式球都可以这样看：先看答案，再用透镜看。

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: Любой трюковой удар можно посмотреть так: сначала решение, потом Линза.

translations.key: Every trick shot can be watched like this: the answer, then the Lens.
translations.text: يمكن مشاهدة كل ضربة خدعة هكذا: الحل أولاً، ثم العدسة.
